title: Full e2e green again; website chatbot settings reach the widget
goal: Make the whole desktop end-to-end suite pass in one run again and make the website chat widget use the greeting and colours the agency saves.
why: Found while merging R103 and R120 (2026-10-14): on launch-readiness the full suite ran 760 passed / 3 failed / 8 did not run; two failures are test defects that also fail without R103 (a date that equals today's date; a duplicated follow-up row), and R120 found that the Website bot tab saves to config channel 'web' while the public widget reads 'website'.
steps: vouchers.spec.ts:241 ('edit, save and the change persists'): getByText('14 Oct 2026', { exact: true }) matches two elements when the run date equals the seeded date. Scope the assertion to the field or section that shows the edited date (or seed a date that can never equal today, e.g. today + 400 days formatted the same way the page does). Fix the test, not the page, unless the page really shows the same date twice by mistake; check which element is which first.

follow-ups.spec.ts:290: a uniquely named follow-up row appeared twice in one run (strict-mode violation) and passed on re-run. Find out whether the list can render a row twice (infinite-scroll page overlap, a second fetch appending instead of replacing, or an automation creating a second follow-up with the same title). If it is an app bug, fix the list or the automation and add a unit test; if it is only test timing, make the wait deterministic. Do not just add .first().

Chatbot config channel: decide one channel name for the website widget. Make the public widget (public-chatbot.ts config/messages) read the same config the Website bot tab saves, migrating the existing value: read 'website' first and fall back to 'web', and make the tab save to 'website'. Update the existing test that expects /chatbot/config/web accordingly and say so.
Run the FULL desktop e2e suite once against a fresh single-mode stack and report the summary; then re-run only failures at most twice.
tests: backend: public widget returns the greeting saved through the staff Website bot tab (new test in backend/test/public-chatbot.test.ts)
desktop e2e: vouchers and follow-ups specs pass three runs in a row
acceptance: Full desktop e2e: 0 failed, 0 did not run (skips only for plan-gated tests).
A greeting saved in the Website bot tab is what the public widget config returns.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # >= 1377 passed
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # >= 1313 passed
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=<web> E2E_API_URL=<api> npx playwright test   # full suite, log to a file outside desktop/test-results
notes: Playwright wipes desktop/test-results at start; write logs elsewhere.
Use MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 for commands that take URL paths as arguments in Git Bash.
